$comment: Build configuration for the <mui-icon> manifest. `mode` chooses what to generate: 'all' bundles the entire @mui/icons-material catalog as lazy-loaded per-variant JSON shards; 'allowlist' bundles only the icons listed below (smaller output). `variants` selects which styles are generated. `inlineCommon` icons (kebab-case) are embedded directly in the component for instant first paint. `emitPerIcon` also writes individual icons/<variant>/<name>.json files used by the runtime 'subset' loading strategy. Run `npm run generate-icons` after editing.
